    • Rakesh Kumar Pradhan
      4 out of 5 stars
      Overall OK
      Reviewed in India on 16 November 2025
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      I have been using the Realme GT 7 Pro for some time now, and overall the experience has been really good.

      Pros:

      The display quality is excellent — bright, vibrant colors and very smooth for gaming and daily use.

      Performance is top-notch. Apps open quickly, multitasking is smooth, and gaming performance is very stable with almost no lag.

      Charging speed is super fast, and the phone goes from low battery to full very quickly.

      Camera quality is impressive in daylight. Portrait shots look sharp and detailed.

      Cons:

      Battery backup could have been slightly better, especially during heavy usage.

      Night mode photos sometimes show a bit of noise.

      The phone heats up a little during long gaming sessions.

    About this Item

    • The 6.78 inch 120Hz Quad-curved display offers smooth and immersive visuals, enhancing daily use, gaming, and video viewing experiences.
    • Long-lasting Battery with Fast Charge​Equipped with a 5800mAh battery, it provides all-day power. The 120W Ultra charge allows for quick recharging when you need to top up.
    • The 124MP AI Cameras capture clear and detailed photos in various scenarios, perfect for preserving everyday moments.
    • Powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite Chipset, it handles multitasking and app operations smoothly.
    • Comes with IP69 protection, ensuring dustproof and water-resistant performance for daily durability.

    Product description

    The realme GT 7 Pro 5G features a 6.78 inch 120Hz Quad-curved display, delivering smooth and immersive visuals for daily use, gaming, and video viewing. Its 5800mAh battery provides all-day power, while 120W Ultra charge ensures quick recharging when needed. With 124MP AI Cameras, it captures clear, detailed photos in various scenarios for everyday moments. Powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite Chipset, it handles multitasking and app operations smoothly. It also comes with IP69 protection, offering dustproof and water-resistant performance for daily durability.
